statements.statement: Finding 4d303267-db2c-4918-9719-3dfb477a4cef, "SQL Injection in 'q' Parameter (/sqli/search)," is a confirmed Critical-severity SQL injection issue where the q parameter produces database syntax details or HTTP 500 responses.

Finding 8c469c3d-25c8-46e0-a4ff-bba7398589ab, "Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in 'name' Parameter (/ssti/render)," is a confirmed Medium-severity reflected XSS issue where executable script markup is reflected unescaped into a text/html response.
